integrity: The crossing formula is proved by matching the source braid length to the universal lower bound 2g+b-1. The volume bound uses the source's single hyperbolic filling parent and strict volume decrease under hyperbolic Dehn filling. The finite script only checks algebraic identities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to m>=3,n>=1 so that asymmetry and hyperbolicity are supplied by the primary source. It gives a uniform volume upper bound, not an exact volume formula or monotonicity statement.
title: Bounded-volume, quadratic-crossing asymmetric L-space knots
